title: backlog.py check refuses an item that holds this host's computer or user name
goal: backlog.py check (and so the push gate) reads this host's computer and user names from the environment and refuses a backlog item holding a piece of either, naming the item and never printing the name; kb/_self/backlog.md says checks that guard against names read them from the environment. Failure it answers (SP-hlfwfcx6 retrospective): BG-477tasb3: checks written to keep the names out of a report spelled pieces of them, and the leak scan (addresses, tokens, GUIDs) does not look for names, so publish took them to the public home.
